notes: S3-FIX2 (decision 2026-11-18 #2): a valid zip container also holds the entry foo, which carries the DOS directory attribute (0x10), whose name does not end with '/' and which declares 1,073,741,825 uncompressed bytes. Only directory entries (names ending '/') and readable/** are left out of the declared total (§11.9 W7 phase 3, §13), so the total is above MAX_CONTAINER_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES: E_CONTAINER_SIZE in phase 3, before the phase-4 E_CONTAINER_ZIP that the attribute with data would give. The Rust verifier left the entry out of the total and reported E_CONTAINER_ZIP before the fix.
